title: Provably Optimal HBT Legalization in Seconds: Certified Optima Reveal Where the Headroom Really Lies
abstract: arXiv:2611.14928v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hybrid bonding terminal (HBT) legalization assigns every terminal of a face-to-face 3D IC to its own pitch-grid site with minimum total Manhattan displacement. Open3DBench reports that a reinforcement-learning (RL) legalizer reduces displacement by 19-22% relative to a sliding-window (SW) heuristic, but none of its legalizers is publicly released. We ask how much displacement any legalizer can still recover. We build an open benchmark of 21 design/pitch instances from Open3DBench placement data, with reconstructed greedy, SW (ViaLegal-style) and BTAssign-style baselines, and GEO-Exact, an exact solver that runs successive shortest augmenting paths over lazily generated spatial candidate edges. An independent dual certificate proves its assignment optimal on all 21 instances (relative primal-dual gap at most $8.2 \times 10^{-16}$). Against these optima, our SW reconstruction with ViaLegal's default configuration is on average 0.011% above

translated_title: 数秒内可证明最优的HBT合法化：认证最优解揭示提升空间究竟在哪里
translated_abstract: 混合键合终端（HBT）合法化将面对式3D IC的每个终端分配到其专属的间距网格单元上，并使总曼哈顿位移最小。Open3DBench报告称，强化学习（RL）合法化器相对于滑动窗口（SW）启发式方法可减少19-22%的位移，但其所有合法化器均未公开发布。我们探究任何合法化器还能恢复多少位移。我们基于Open3DBench布局数据构建了一个包含21个设计/间距实例的开放基准，涵盖重构的贪婪算法、SW（ViaLegal风格）与BTAssign风格基线，以及GEO-Exact——一种在延迟生成的空间候选边上运行连续最短增广路径的精确求解器。独立对偶证书证明其分配结果在全部21个实例上均为最优（相对原始-对偶间隙至多8.2×10⁻¹⁶）。与这些最优解相比，采用ViaLegal默认配置的SW重构平均仅高出0.011%……
tldr: 本文构建了包含精确求解器GEO-Exact及独立对偶最优性证书的开放HBT合法化基准，证明滑动窗口启发式方法距全局最优仅差0.011%，从而揭示了合法化算法的真实提升空间所在。
